houseControl.fact: NBC News projects Democrats win control of the House. Democrats held 252 seats to 162 for Republicans with 21 uncalled; 218 are needed.
houseControl.sourceLabel: NBC News, U.S. House Elections 2026 Live Results: Democrats Win Control (updated Nov. 9, 8:06 AM ET)

expectedLeaders.name: Richard Neal
expectedLeaders.role: Expected chairman, Committee on Ways and Means, 120th Congress
expectedLeaders.fact: Neal is poised to chair Ways and Means a second time after the election of a new Democratic House majority; he called it a rare opportunity.
expectedLeaders.sourceLabel: MassLive via Yahoo News, 'Not a bad portfolio': Ways & Means chairmanship puts Neal at center of Social Security, taxes, tariffs, retirement, IRS

expectedLeaders.name: Jason Smith
expectedLeaders.role: Expected ranking member, Committee on Ways and Means, 120th Congress
expectedLeaders.fact: Bloomberg Tax reported before the election that if Democrats win the House, Smith and Neal would swap titles; Democrats won. No formal GOP conference vote yet.
expectedLeaders.sourceLabel: Bloomberg Tax, Powerful Tax-Writing Panels to Lose Experience After Midterms
